info.description: HTTP API for managing Machinarchy environments, SSH hosts, and job history.
info.title: Machinarchy API

post.description: Authenticates an account, returns a JWT, and sets the auth_token cookie.
Creates an account, returns a JWT, and sets the auth_token cookie.

get.description: Requires a human workspace owner session; API tokens are refused. Events are append-only and never contain credentials. Page backwards by passing the smallest id received as before_id.

parameters.description: Only events with this action, for example member.role_changed
parameters.name: action

parameters.description: Only events with a smaller id (paging cursor)
parameters.name: before_id

get.description: Requires a human workspace owner session. Recomputes every event's hash and link. A valid result proves no earlier event was edited, removed, or reordered; it cannot detect events removed from the end, so record headHash somewhere outside the database to detect that.

post.description: Resolves a selector with explicit include and exclude lists against the workspace inventory and lists the matching hosts (at most 500; total is always exact), the hosts removed by the exclude list, and include/exclude entries that matched no host. Nothing is contacted or changed, and no credentials are returned.

get.description: Optionally filters with a label selector such as `environment=production,role in (web,db),!canary`. Built-in fields are name, hostname, address, status, connection, and environment; any other key is a label. Values may use the wildcards * and ?. An empty or invalid selector is rejected rather than treated as "all".

post.description: Registers a host after validating SSH connectivity and the expected host-key fingerprint. SecretData contains the SSH password or private key and is never returned.

parameters.description: Host connection details; provide either ip or hostname. SecretData is the SSH password or private key and is never returned.
parameters.name: request

post.description: Registers many hosts in one request with partial-success semantics: each record is validated, checked for duplicates (name or address:port, against the inventory and earlier records), SSH-verified against its pinned fingerprint, and stored independently. The response is 200 whenever the request itself is valid; inspect each result's status. Set validate_only to check records without contacting hosts or storing anything. SecretData is never returned. No commands are executed.

put.description: Updates host metadata and credentials. SecretData contains the SSH password or private key and is never returned.

patch.description: Applies the changes atomically on top of the host's current labels, so unrelated labels and all connection settings are untouched and concurrent patches do not overwrite each other. Keys are 1-63 characters of letters, digits, '.', '_', '-', or '/'; values may be empty or up to 63 characters; a host may have at most 50 labels; the built-in selector field names (id, name, hostname, address, status, environment, connection) are reserved.

get.description: Requires a human workspace owner session. API tokens are refused.

put.description: Requires a human workspace owner session. Takes effect on the member's next request, including for API tokens, whose effective role never exceeds the membership role. A workspace must always keep at least one owner. The change is recorded in the structured server log.

get.description: Newest first, without arguments or per-host results. Requires operations read permission.

parameters.description: Only runs with a smaller id (paging cursor)
parameters.name: before_id

post.description: Disabled unless the server enables execution and lists the allowed programs. Requires the runs:execute permission (owners and operators). The command is an argument list with no shell, the targets are resolved and pinned when the run is accepted, and the run executes in the background: poll GET /api/v1/runs/{id}. Output is combined stdout and stderr. Commands are never retried; a timeout or cancellation does not prove the command did not run. The 202 response carries the run; with dryRun the plan is returned with 200 and nothing is stored or contacted.

409.description: The targeted hosts changed since the preview

get.description: Callers with the runs:execute permission also see the arguments and each host's output; others see only status, exit codes, and errors.

post.description: Stops new hosts from starting and closes running SSH sessions. A command that was already sent may still have run, or keep running, on its host; cancelled hosts are reported as such. Requires the runs:execute permission.

get.description: Requires a human workspace owner session. Returns metadata for tokens created by the current user; plaintext secrets are never returned.

post.description: Requires a human workspace owner session. Tokens are limited to operator or reader and their effective access cannot exceed the owner's current workspace membership role. Plaintext is returned only in this response.

delete.description: Requires a human workspace owner session. The revoked token is rejected on its next request.

headHash.description:
HeadHash is the hash of the newest event. Record it somewhere outside the
database (a ticket, a log line) to detect later truncation of the tail.

argv.description:
Argv is only returned to callers allowed to execute; it may contain
sensitive values and is stored encrypted.

cancelRequested.description: CancelRequested is set when cancellation was asked for.

hosts.description:
Hosts is omitted from listings. Output is only included for callers
allowed to execute.

excluded.description: Excluded lists hosts that were selected but removed by the exclude list.

targetsHash.description:
TargetsHash identifies the exact targeted hosts (all of them, not only the
listed ones). A run can require it so it runs on what was reviewed.

total.description: Total is the number of targeted hosts; Hosts lists at most MaxPreviewHosts of them.

all.description: All explicitly targets every host; it cannot be combined with selector or include.

exclude.description: Exclude removes hosts by ID or name, always winning over selector and include.

include.description: Include adds hosts by ID or name regardless of the selector.

selector.description: Selector is a label selector, for example environment=production,role in (web,db),!canary.

validate_only.description:
ValidateOnly checks records and duplicates without contacting hosts or
storing anything.

argv.description:
Argv is the program followed by its arguments. There is no shell: each
element reaches the program as exactly one argument.

concurrency.description: Concurrency bounds hosts processed at once (default 5, maximum 20).

dryRun.description: DryRun validates and plans without storing a run or contacting any host.

expectTargetsHash.description:
ExpectTargetsHash, copied from a preview, makes the request fail with 409
unless it would run on exactly the previewed hosts.

selector.description:
Selector, Include, Exclude, and All form the target rule exactly as in the
target preview. At least one of selector, include, or all is required.

timeoutSeconds.description: TimeoutSeconds bounds the command on each host (default 60, maximum 900).

BearerAuth.description: Supply a JWT as `Bearer <token>`. The API also accepts the auth_token cookie.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
